description: Elect a leader from public Bootstrap/Campaign in two- and three-voter clusters, propose one unique payload per cluster, drain all eligible work with the leader append worker held, observe commitment against matching stored replica count, release that worker and drain again. The three-voter held phase exercises a permitted follower-majority commit; final scenario events report committed and applied endpoints. Each observation has an independent scenario/phase ID emitted before its schedule.

harness.description: Serialized public RawNode driver with deterministic FIFO local storage workers and in-memory network. Four finite checkpoint operations over two complete proposal histories.
semantic_changes: No implementation modifications; same-package access reads target index, self Match and applied index only.
MemoryStorage substitutes for durable backend completion. No crash recovery or filesystem durability claim.
Derived booleans compare raw leader commit >= target index and matching persisted replica count >= configured majority. Raw operands are emitted.

legality.derivation: Create each RawNode with MemoryStorage and Bootstrap identical peers; drain bootstrap entries and invoke ApplyConfChange only on emitted committed configuration entries. Campaign through the public method and deliver actual produced messages until a leader emerges. Propose through RawNode; no term, role, log, tracker or commit assignments occur. Each local append queue processes FIFO and publishes carried responses only after writes. Apply queues are independently FIFO and consume real entries; public Step receives actual produced responses. After the proposal only the leader append worker is finitely held, which async-contract permits while other workers run; all held work is subsequently released. No Advance is called in async mode. The loop stops on lack of eligible work or a driver budget independently of the forbidden commitment predicate.
legality.applicability: Two separate clusters with two and three voters, no post-bootstrap configuration changes, no crashes, drops or ticks during the selected interval. The finite drain budget is a driver limit, not a liveness conclusion.
alternatives: Synchronous Ready has different caller ordering, so this driver is restricted to the async public API.

grounding.derivation: The implementation explicitly requires entries to be persisted before being counted toward commitment (durability-expectation). The async contract permits outgoing replication before local writes but requires storage-worker responses after ordered durable completion. Under a fixed simple voting configuration, commitment may use any majority of persisted matching replicas; it does not require the leader itself to have persisted when other replicas form a majority. This requirement is independent of the observed committed value and of a blanket expectation that delayed local writes block every commit.
grounding.applicability: Non-Byzantine peers; stable fixed simple voter membership; async storage mode; current-term ordinary proposal; honest ordered storage workers, no crashes or data corruption. MemoryStorage represents successfully completed storage writes at the library boundary; no physical disk durability is measured.
alternatives: A three-voter leader may legally commit using both followers while its own append worker is delayed.

observable_properties.description: At each completed scheduled checkpoint, commitment of the target implies a majority of independently inspected MemoryStorage replicas contain the target term/index/payload. No requirement for commitment is inferred from a merely available quorum.

uncertainties: Observations cover these fixed schedules and two cluster sizes, not all asynchronous interleavings.
MemoryStorage completion represents the embedding durability promise; actual crash durability is outside this check.
